title: Nina Kulagina stops the hearts of animals

tellings.quote: Um, the Russians after they got all of this had a woman named Nina Cologa who was stopping the hearts of rats and rabbits and things like that

plain: After the Soviets picked up research into mind powers, they had a woman named Nina Kulagina who could stop the hearts of rats, rabbits and other animals, according to a former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan. Buchanan, who calls her "Nina Cologa", tells it without naming a source. He brings it up as a sign of how far Soviet work on psychic powers is said to have gone.
